# Perseús, translated into industries: what the archetype actually does

The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Perseús** works now.

The stories of Perseus place hero, slayer of medousa at the center of a living mythological world.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Perseús
- **Pantheon:** Greek
- **Domain of influence:** Hero, Slayer of Medousa
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Commerce & Governance · Culture & Entertainment · Society & Spirit
- **Strongest seat:** Defense, Military & Security
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 388 of 546

## The Myth at Work

**Origins.** Perseus appears in greek tradition as hero, slayer of medousa.  The name's meaning, "Destroyer, possibly Persian", shapes the narratives told about this figure. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

**Worship and Memory.** Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Perseus in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Defense, Military & Security

*Defense contracting, security services, and strategic studies. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*Primary seat: Perseus embodies hero, slayer of medousa — the core of defense.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Gaming, Fantasy & Entertainment IP

*Video games, streaming franchises, and fantasy worlds. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Resonant seat: Perseus shares symbolic territory with gaming entertainment.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### History, Archives & Records

*Museums, archives, libraries, and the record-keeping professions. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*Resonant seat: Perseus shares symbolic territory with history archives.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Sports, Fitness & Competition

*Athletics, fitness brands, and competitive leagues. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

*Resonant seat: Perseus shares symbolic territory with sports athletics.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

## The Long Employment

Perseus remains a touchstone for understanding greek religion, art, and identity. The age changed. The work did not.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity’s documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in defense, military & security, gaming, fantasy & entertainment ip, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/perseus/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
